definitions.explanation: The furthest point or boundary of something.

definitions.gloss: as far as, as long as
definitions.explanation: To the extent that something is true or continues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{限|かぎ}り⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: I ran with all my might.
As far as I know, he shouldn't be coming.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{限|かぎ}り⟦{手伝|てつだ}います→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: I'll help as long as I have time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{限|かぎ}り⟦{叫|さけ}んだ→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧。
examples.english: I shouted at the top of my lungs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{限|かぎ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There are limits to physical stamina, so please don't overdo it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{限|かぎ}り、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: As long as the weather is good, I go for a walk every morning.

notes:
{限|かぎ}り is used for limits and conditional expressions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{限|かぎ}り: to the limit of ~
  - ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{限|かぎ}り: with all one's might
  - ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{限|かぎ}り: at the top of one's voice
- ～{限|かぎ}り: as far as ~, as long as ~
  - ⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧{限|かぎ}り: as far as I know
  - ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧{限|かぎ}り: as much as possible
- ～⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧{限|かぎ}り: unless ~
  - ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧{限|かぎ}り: unless you make an effort

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {限|かぎ}り⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: endlessly, infinitely
- {限|かぎ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is a limit
- {限|かぎ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no limit
